tasks.short: Review whether credits and deductions are allowed.

steps.what: Compare claimed credits with the published allowance.
Review whether the deduction is allowed on this return.
Determine the credit result the agent will stand behind.

tasks.design: A claimed credit code is compared in the {ERP} with the published allowance. The revenue agent reviews the filed return and determines whether the credit or the deduction is allowed on these facts. A code the allowance does not name is not passed. The compare does not allow the claim.
tasks.previous_blocker: Credits were allowed because the code looked familiar, against a rule that had changed.
tasks.enabler_now: A claimed code can be compared with the published allowance before the agent reads the facts.
tasks.still_hard: A code that is published and still does not fit this return.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a matching code on facts the allowance does not cover.
tasks.altitude: Published codes are compared first. The agent still determines whether this return is allowed the claim. An unnamed code is not passed.

reach.task: Match a code to a published measure and still decide the line that does not fit.
reach.learn: The compare can run. The allowance decision stays here.

evidence.claim: A claimed credit code can be compared with a published allowance. The compare cannot decide that this return is allowed the credit.
The agent determines the allowance. A code match is not the decision.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Return id, credit code, and allowance id, produced by the return and the published allowance. A code with no allowance id is not passed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the allowance list the office already publishes.
unknowns: Which allowance list is in force.
Who may allow a credit besides the agent.
research_questions: What share of claims use a published code?
Which deductions are always read on the facts?

already_counted.description: The agent still reviews whether the deduction is allowed.
The agent still determines the result.

incremental.description: The agent reads a claim the allowance list did not name.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is comparing a claimed code with a published allowance. It disappears when the code is not in the list and the agent reads the return. Determining whether the credit is allowed stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep up with tax code changes.

steps.what: List code changes that name a section on the watch list.
Evaluate whether the change affects the accounting procedure.
Record the financial information the agent will use.

tasks.design: Code changes are listed in {DOCS} only when they name a section already on the watch list. The revenue agent evaluates whether the accounting procedure or the financial information changes, including the decision that nothing changes. An item that names no listed section is not summarised. A note cites only a section in the file.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agent heard of a change from a colleague and could not find the section.
tasks.enabler_now: Items that name a listed section can be gathered before the agent reads them.
tasks.still_hard: A change that matters and does not name a listed section.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can tell that a matching section does not change the procedure this office uses.
tasks.altitude: Listed sections are gathered. The agent still evaluates the financial information and still decides, including that nothing changes.

reach.task: Filter a feed to named sections and still decide whether a procedure changes.
reach.learn: The filter can run. The evaluation stays here.

evidence.claim: A feed can be filtered to sections already on a watch list. The filter cannot evaluate the financial information.
The agent decides whether a procedure changes, including that it does not. A note cites only a section already in the file.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.
Fields: Section id, produced by the watch list. An item that names no listed section is not summarised. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the official texts the office already watches.
unknowns: Which sections are on the watch list.
Who else must agree before a procedure changes.
research_questions: How many feed items name a listed section?
Which changes are left as no action?

already_counted.description: The agent still evaluates whether the procedure changes.
The agent still records the financial information to use.

incremental.description: The agent reads an item the filter left out.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is filtering the feed to sections already listed. It disappears when an item names no listed section and the agent reads it. Evaluating the change stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate a claim of inability to pay.

steps.what: Retrieve a lien or mortgage status already in the register.
Investigate the claim of inability to pay the taxes.
Record assets found through the third party search.

tasks.design: A lien or mortgage status is retrieved from the {ERP} only when the register already holds that id. The revenue agent investigates the claim of inability to pay, including court information and assets located through third parties. A missing id stops the extract. The extract does not decide the claim, and people are not placed on a list for claiming inability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Lien status was requested by letter and the answer arrived after the interview.
tasks.enabler_now: A known lien id can be retrieved before the agent investigates.
tasks.still_hard: An asset a third party will not confirm, and a claim the register does not illuminate.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a clear register and still not believe the claim.
tasks.altitude: A known lien status can be on the file. The agent still investigates the claim and still records the assets. No list is built of people who say they cannot pay.

reach.task: Pull a known register entry and still investigate the rest.
reach.learn: The status can be retrieved. The investigation stays here.

evidence.claim: A lien or mortgage status can be retrieved when the id is already in the register. The extract cannot judge inability to pay.
A fraud list that selected people without a legal basis, with nationality as a factor, is not a way to choose a case. A return is listed only when a logged arithmetic rule has failed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.
Fields: Lien id or mortgage id, produced by the register. An id the register does not hold is not retrieved. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the register the office is already allowed to consult. No list of claimants is created.
unknowns: Which registers the office may consult.
research_questions: What share of claims have a lien id?
Which investigations are always done by the agent?

already_counted.description: The agent still investigates the claim.
The agent still records the assets found.

incremental.description: The agent requests a status the register did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is retrieving a lien or mortgage status already in the register. It disappears when the id is missing and the agent researches it. Investigating inability to pay stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Decide the extent of the audit.

steps.what: List returns that failed a logged arithmetic rule.
Review the selected return and determine the audit extent.
Record the nature of the audit to be performed.

tasks.design: A return is listed in the {ERP} only when a logged arithmetic rule has failed. The revenue agent reviews that return and determines the nature and extent of the audit. Nationality and a fraud score are not inputs. A return that failed no logged rule is not listed. The list does not set the audit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Returns were selected from a personal sense of which taxpayers looked risky.
tasks.enabler_now: A failed arithmetic rule can put the return on a list the agent then reviews.
tasks.still_hard: A return that failed a rule and still needs no audit, and one that passed every rule and still worries the agent.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a failed total that is a typing error, not an audit.
tasks.altitude: Failed arithmetic rules are visible. The agent still determines the extent of the audit. No fraud list and no nationality field chooses the return.

reach.task: Open a case that failed a stated rule and still decide the inspection.
reach.learn: The rule result can be listed. The audit extent stays here.

evidence.claim: A return can be listed when a logged arithmetic rule has failed. The list cannot set the extent of the audit.
A fraud list that selected people without a legal basis, with nationality as a factor, is not a way to choose a case. A return is listed only when a logged arithmetic rule has failed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Return id and rule id, produced by the logged arithmetic check. A return that failed no logged rule is not listed. Nationality is not a field in this list. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the arithmetic checks the office already logs. No fraud score is stored.
unknowns: Who may open an audit the list did not show.
research_questions: What share of reviews start from a failed logged rule?
Which audits are opened with no failed rule?

already_counted.description: The agent still determines the extent of the audit.
The agent still records the nature of the audit.

incremental.description: The agent opens a return the rule list did not show.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is listing returns that failed a logged arithmetic rule. It disappears when the agent reviews a return the rule did not flag. Setting the extent of the audit stays with the agent. No fraud list is used.

role.altitude: The agent still decides whether a credit is allowed, still chooses the audit, and still investigates a claim of inability to pay. A published allowance and a failed arithmetic rule can be ready before that work.
reach: Regulatory affairs specialists filter a feed to named sections and still decide whether anything changes, and this job learns the same limit on tax code changes.
Environmental compliance inspectors do not choose a site by a score, and this job learns an audit is not chosen by a fraud list.
skills_to_grow: Allow a credit only when the published rule names it and the agent agrees the facts.
Put a return on the audit list only when a logged arithmetic rule failed.
role.ambitious_version: Published allowances and failed arithmetic checks are visible before the agent decides, and a fraud list does not choose the case.
